claim_tested: Does loss of EIN3 (ein3-1) alter submergence/hypoxia tolerance?
key_finding: ein3-1 'not significantly different to wild type under either DS or LS'; OE-1 ein3-1 remained hypoxia-sensitive like OE-1
context: Arabidopsis Col-0, 4-wk rosettes; 2-day dark submergence / 8-day light submergence + 3-day recovery
confidence_limitations: High that result is null for EIN3; qualitative claim - no n or statistics reported

claim_tested: Which pathways does the ACBP3-OE hypoxia phenotype depend on?
key_finding: Phenotype 'dependent on NPR1- and CTR1-mediated signaling pathways' (EIN3 excluded)
confidence_limitations: High; primary conclusion is about ACBP3/NPR1/CTR1 not EIN3

claim_tested: Does ethylene signalling (EIN2 EIN3/EIL1) mediate hypoxia pre-adaptation?
key_finding: Ethylene->PGB1->NO depletion->ERFVII stabilization pre-adapts to hypoxia; response abolished in ethylene-signalling mutants incl. ein3eil1-1; EIN3-GFP reports ethylene perception
context: Arabidopsis root/shoot meristems; 4h ethylene/submergence pre-treatment then <0.01% O2
confidence_limitations: Medium-high; supports EIN3/EIL1 pair; upstream/indirect; abstract does not name EIN3

claim_tested: Which TFs directly activate hypoxia-responsive genes?
key_finding: Group VII ERFs (RAP2.2/2.12 principal; RAP2.3; HRE1/2 minor) bind hypoxia-responsive promoter element
context: Arabidopsis, single/double null mutants, Y1H, ChIP
confidence_limitations: High; ERF-VIIs not EIN3 are direct hypoxia transcriptional effectors
